Results.ReviewText: I have been grilling on a Q2200 for years but decided that I wanted to move up to the Spirit II e210. The reasons being the sturdy cart, the flavorizer bars protecting the burner tubes, and just the overall fit and finish of the Spirit II. The Spirit II was easy to assemble as the instructions were clear and everything aligned perfectly. It took me 2 hours and 3 beers to complete but I took my time. I’ve done a couple of cooks and the grill works perfectly. It now sits next to my Weber Performer charcoal grill. And the Q2200 will now be residing permanently at our beach house.
Results.Title: The Spirit of Weber

Results.ReviewText: I bought the Spirit E-210 to replace a much larger Genesis series grill which was totally worn out and broken after almost 20 years of use  I am 73 years old and no longer need a grill that large. The first think I noticed was that the newer Genesis models were made of much thinner metal tan was used 20 years ago. The Spirit II E-210 uses even lighter weight materials than the current Genesis models. I am trusting that the internal components are of higher quality than those of other brands. It is still February and to cold for me to want to do any grilling yet, so i have no experience using this grill.
Results.Title: Lighter weight materials than in the past

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
